subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible `/agent <id>` temporary switch, and what allowlist/session ownership contract should authorize moving a conversation between configured agents?
rationale: The feature crosses routing, session ownership, memory isolation, workspace access, and tool credential boundaries, so automation cannot choose the product and security contract safely.

options.title: Add an opt-in secure conversation switch
options.body: Implement a conversation-level configured-agent binding with explicit authorization, per-agent session isolation, and bounded cleanup semantics.

options.title: Keep only existing focus/subagent flows
options.body: Decline direct-chat agent switching and steer users to configured bindings, TUI switching, or thread-bound `/focus` workflows where supported.

options.title: Defer to a plugin experiment first
options.body: Keep core unchanged until a plugin proves the UX and security model and identifies any missing core API seam.

recommendation.title: Add an opt-in secure conversation switch
recommendation.body: Implement a conversation-level configured-agent binding with explicit authorization, per-agent session isolation, and bounded cleanup semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest shipped command and binding model is the thread-bound subagent work from PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/21805.
